name_input: BHARAT WIRE ROPES LIMITED; BHARAT WIRE ROPES LIMITED; BHARAT WIRE ROPES LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (slug 'bharat-wire-ropes-limited', address 701/A Wing Trade World, Kamla City, Senapati Bapat Marg, Lower Parel-W) reports 'Total Shipments 310' and 'Latest Cargo 2026-02-17'. Exact export row quoted: '2026-01-15 | BHARAT WIRE ROPES LIMITED | MASTER OF LNG / C RAAHI | GALVANIZED STEEL WIRE ROPES (DETAILS AS PER ANNEX. PACKING LIST ATTACHED) | NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India -> Jebel Ali, UNITED ARAB EMIRATES | HS 73121020 | BOL 8787183'. Second export lane visible in buyer list: 'NEPAL RASTRA BANK ... BHARAT WIRE ROPES LIMITED, SINGHMAHAL, THAPATHALI, KATHMANDU, NEPAL' (46 shipments) and 'BRUGG LIFTING ... WYDENSTRASSE 36 CH-5242 BIRR' (4 shipments). Source counter: page claims 310 total shipments / 10 trading partners / 15 ports; rows actually visible in free view = 5 dated shipment rows (4 imports + 1 export) plus 5 supplier rows and 5 buyer rows. So export rows actually seen = 1 dated B/L with HS + destination; the rest are aggregate counters, not individual records.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved: DuckDuckGo search backend returned 'no results (searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>)' on both queries, and volza.com and eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403. Domestic supply therefore not verified either way — null, not public in the sources reachable within the call budget.
note: Real export shipments are confirmed by dated customs/B-L records, not by website claims: HS 73121020 galvanized steel wire ropes shipped Nhava Sheva -> Jebel Ali (UAE) on 2026-01-15 under B/L 8787183, plus Nepal Rastra Bank and Brugg Lifting as recurring consignees. Declared HS set 721790;731210;831120 is consistent with the observed 73121020 export line; the other two codes were not observed in the free view and are not contradicted. The company is also a substantial importer (sisal yarn HS 58089090 from Nanning Konun, China, B/L 7582481 dated 2026-02-17; Nyrosten corrosion protection HS 34031900 from Germany, B/L 7276887 dated 2026-02-03), which is consistent with a manufacturer/trader profile rather than a pure exporter. Caveat on evidence depth: the free ImportKey view exposes only 5 dated rows against a claimed 310 shipments, so the export finding rests on one fully quoted B/L plus aggregate consignee counters — sufficient to call export_status confirmed, but the full shipment history is paywalled. Domestic (India) supply side is genuinely unverified, not absent: search and two secondary aggregators were unreachable, so domestic_status is unknown rather than none_found. No revenue or export-volume figures are public in the reachable sources, so both are null and were not estimated.
